biological_support.statistical_interpretation: RNA shows a coherent inflammatory/immune-up pattern with large standardized mean differences and strong FDR control (26/50 pathways at q<0.05). CNV shows a coherent pattern of higher VHL/SETD2/PBRM1/chr20q and more chr14q loss and CDKN2A loss in C0001, with 19/49 continuous features and 5/107 gain/loss features significant. WXS shows nominal PBRM1 and VHL depletion in C0001 but no feature survives BH correction (min q=0.223), so mutation evidence is weak and uncertain. The RNA and CNV directions are internally coherent and mutually compatible (immune/inflammatory up with specific CNV alterations), while WXS provides only nominal, non-FDR-significant support.
biological_support.medical_interpretation: C0001 is characterized by upregulated inflammatory/IL6-JAK-STAT3 and allograft-rejection Hallmark programs and downregulated pancreas-beta-cell and heme-metabolism programs, alongside CNV differences at VHL, SETD2, PBRM1, chr20q, chr14q, and CDKN2A. These are molecular characterizations of the current partition; they do not by themselves establish a distinct biological subtype or clinical behavior.
limitations: WXS findings are not significant after BH correction.
RNA and CNV effect sizes are moderate and derived from a single partition; no independent validation cohort is available.
Clinical characterization is auxiliary and not used as molecular support.

cross_modal_consistency.statistical_interpretation: C0001 shows weak but positive fixed-membership median silhouettes across all five modalities, with RNA strongest (0.021) and CT/WSI weakest. Patient membership support is moderate (median 3 of 5 modalities positive; 20.3% of patients positive across all estimable modalities). The internal SNF probe is estimable with high fraction silhouette positive (0.913) and moderate resampling stability (ARI 0.604), but very small median silhouette (0.0003). The C0001-C0002 boundary is weak in the fused space (pair median silhouette 0.00024) and modest in RNA (0.0244); WXS boundary is weak on the C0001 side (left boundary separation 0.005). PERMANOVA R2 is small across modalities (0.013-0.031). PERMDISP is significant for WSI and CNV (q=0.0425), indicating dispersion differences that may contribute to the apparent separation. These are structural characterizations of the current partition, not independent validation.
cross_modal_consistency.medical_interpretation: C0001 is structurally supported by weak-to-modest cross-modal affinity signals, with RNA providing the strongest internal cohesion and CT/WSI the weakest. The boundary between C0001 and C0002 is weak in the fused space, and significant WSI/CNV dispersion differences suggest that separation may partly reflect within-group variability rather than a sharp biological boundary.
limitations: Silhouette values are small and structural characterization does not independently validate biological subtype identity.
PERMDISP is an approximate diagnostic and negative PCoA eigenvalues were discarded.
Resampling was performed on the existing SNF affinity subgraph; modality affinities and SNF were not re-estimated.

reports.statistical_interpretation: C0002 shows positive fixed-membership median silhouettes in WSI, RNA, and CNV, with RNA strongest (0.0385) and CNV next (0.0234); CT and WXS are near zero. Patient membership support is moderate (median 3 of 5 modalities positive; 11.8% of patients positive across all estimable modalities). The internal SNF probe is estimable with high fraction silhouette positive (0.912) and moderate resampling stability (ARI 0.590), but very small median silhouette (0.0003). The C0002-C0001 boundary is weak in the fused space (pair median silhouette 0.00024) and modest in RNA (0.0244); WXS boundary is weak on the C0002 side (right boundary separation 0.198). PERMANOVA R2 is small across modalities (0.013-0.031). PERMDISP is significant for WSI and CNV (q=0.0425), indicating dispersion differences that may contribute to the apparent separation. These are structural characterizations of the current partition, not independent validation.
reports.medical_interpretation: C0002 is structurally supported by weak-to-modest cross-modal affinity signals, with RNA and CNV providing the strongest internal cohesion and CT/WXS the weakest. The boundary between C0002 and C0001 is weak in the fused space, and significant WSI/CNV dispersion differences suggest that separation may partly reflect within-group variability rather than a sharp biological boundary.
limitations: Silhouette values are small and structural characterization does not independently validate biological subtype identity.
PERMDISP is an approximate diagnostic and negative PCoA eigenvalues were discarded.
Resampling was performed on the existing SNF affinity subgraph; modality affinities and SNF were not re-estimated.

reports.statistical_interpretation: Stage and grade are both fully available (n=103, no missingness) and estimable. ARI is near zero and slightly negative for both stage (-0.034) and grade (-0.014), indicating essentially no agreement beyond chance between the partition and either label. Homogeneity and completeness are low for both labels (stage 0.027/0.049; grade 0.041/0.067), consistent with weak one-to-one correspondence. Stage and grade are assessed independently; neither shows a simple echo of the partition.
reports.medical_interpretation: The current partition is not a simple echo of TCGA stage or grade. Low overlap means only that the partition is not explained by these labels; it is not proof of molecular novelty. Published molecular ccRCC subtype taxonomies were not evaluated in the current data.
limitations: Only TCGA stage and grade labels are assessable.
